name: Nijoukubo
source:
Affiliation: The Corporation
Bug: Dragonfly
Ability: Evacuation - Multi-Monitor. The weakest bug in Company history. Deploys a floating, movable tattoo-like symbol that acts as additional eyes, ears and nose for the user. While the Dragonfly itself is immune against all forms of physical interaction, it has zero fighting capabilities as well, forcing Nijoukubo to stay clear away from battles and rely on others to fight on her stead.

The protagonist of the story, Nijoukubo accompanies her best friend Sanbara on the latter's research trip on bug mythology. Inexperienced and unfamiliar with the supernatural or the workings of the twisted game she finds herself in, she mostly follows more experienced Sanbara's lead and acts in a supporting role.
